introduction: PA 211 helps residents find nearby assistance services through a free, confidential referral service.
description: PA 211 helps residents find nearby assistance services through a free, confidential referral service.

sections.who: People seeking resources can contact the service. Individual agencies set their own eligibility and intake rules.
sections.get: You can obtain referrals for local needs and contact details. The navigator does not approve the referred benefit.
sections.docs:
• Your ZIP code.
  • The problem and any urgent deadline.
  • Language or accessibility needs.
sections.apply:
1. Call or text

    Dial 211 or text your ZIP code to 898-211. Search PA 211 online.

  2. Describe the need

    Tell the specialist what help is most urgent.

  3. Contact referrals

    Ask each provider about availability and the next intake step.
sections.after: Return to 211 if a provider is closed or cannot help and ask for other local options.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using PA 211. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
